date_note: Disclosed in a regulatory filing 'on Monday' (23 November) per IANS; the page gives no earlier day.
exec: Suzlon Energy says it has reported a cyber incident to CERT-In and sees no impact on business-critical applications at this stage.
geo_basis: country; the source gives no city
plain: Indian wind-energy company Suzlon says it was hit by a cyber incident, has reported it to India's national cyber agency and took immediate action. It says business-critical applications are not affected at this stage.
summary: Suzlon Energy said in a disclosure, quoted by Business Today and IANS, that it "has been impacted by a cyber incident". It says it took immediate action to mitigate it and reported it to CERT-In. Suzlon says no impact is observed on business-critical applications at this stage. The reports give no detail on the nature of the incident.
title: Suzlon Energy says it reported a cyber incident to CERT-In

validation.note: Two publishers (IANS (ianslive.in) and Business Today) each quote Suzlon's own disclosure that it was impacted by a cyber incident and reported it to CERT-In; the filing itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, date, incident response, containment, CERT-In report and no-impact statement against IANS article; single source, developing
